name: Overlord Krom'gar
summary: Overlord Krom'gar is an aggressive orc commander seeking to claim total control over the crags of the Stonetalon Mountains. Representing hardline Horde expansionism, he advocates for the decisive expulsion of Alliance presence from the region.

sections.title: Horde Expansion in Stonetalon
sections.body: Within the rocky passes of the Stonetalon Mountains, Overlord Krom'gar champions aggressive military action to secure Kalimdor for the Horde. Uncompromising in his ambition, Krom'gar believes that securing the peaks against night elven and Alliance outposts requires overwhelming force and steadfast discipline among the ranks.

faq.answer: Overlord Krom'gar is an uncompromising orc commander dedicated to securing Horde dominance across the peaks of Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What is his role in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: He commands forward Horde forces in the region, focusing on driving out Alliance presence and expanding Horde territory through aggressive military mobilization.
General Grebo serves as his second-in-command, helping oversee the soldiers under Krom'gar's leadership.

angles.text: For Horde warriors, Krom'gar represents an aggressive vision of territorial expansion that demands unwavering loyalty and ruthlessness against encroaching enemies.
Orcs fighting in Stonetalon encounter in Krom'gar a fierce dedication to martial strength and total dominance over the wilderness.
